ask: %s leaves three keepsakes. Take one: it is yours for the rest of the run.

ember_heart.name: EMBER HEART
ember_heart.text: 6 more max HP, and all your health back

sharp_tooth.name: SHARP TOOTH
sharp_tooth.text: every strike of yours that lands does 2 more

steady_hand.name: STEADY HAND
steady_hand.text: the perfect mark on the strike bar is twice as wide

thick_hide.name: THICK HIDE
thick_hide.text: every hit in the box costs 1 less

quick_feet.name: QUICK FEET
quick_feet.text: close calls count from further out, so nerve comes easier

open_hand.name: OPEN HAND
open_hand.text: every monster is 15% likelier to take mercy

lucky_coin.name: LUCKY COIN
lucky_coin.text: half again as much gold from every purse and chest

second_wind.name: SECOND WIND
second_wind.text: once a fight, the hit that would fell you leaves you on 1 HP
